simple.meaning: קָוָה (qâvâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect ; (figuratively) to expect.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 49 times across Genesis, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 1:9. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָוָה (H6960).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָוָה (qâvâh) / H6960 is traced through Genesis 1:9, Genesis 49:18, Job 3:9, Job 6:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H6960. qavah I. [ קָוָה ] verb wait for (probably originally twist, stretch , then of tension of enduring, waiting: Assyrian ‡ûû II, I. wait , ‡û , cord ; Arabic be strong , strength , also strand of rope; Syriac endure, remain, await , threads , so קַוִּין ᵑ7 spider's threads, web ); — Qal Participle plural those waiting for ( ׳י ): construct י ׳קוֵי Psa 37:9 ; so Isa 40:31 van d. H., and Kt Baer Gi (Qr קוֺיֵי ); suffix קִוָ֑י 49:23 , קֹוֶיךָ Psa 25:3 ; 69:7 ; קִוָיו Lam 3:35 Qr (Kt קוו , i.e. קֹווֺ ). Pi`el Perfect 3feminine singular קִוְּתָה Psa 130:5 ; 1 singular קִוִּיתִי Gen 49:18 5 t., קִוֵּיתִי Isa 5:4 , ׳וְק consecutive 8:17 ; suffix קִוִּיתִיךָ Psa 25:21 ; 3 plural קִוּוּ 56:7 +, etc.; Imperfect יְקַוֶּה Micah 5:6 ; Job 7:2 , jussive יְקַו 3:9 , וַיְקַו Isa 5:2 , 7 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular קַוֵּה Hosea 12:7 +; Infinitive absolute קַוֺה Psa 40:2 , קַוֵּה Jer 8:15 ; 14:19 ; — 1 wait , or look eagerly, for , with ל of thing Isa 5:7 ; 59:9 , 11 ; Jer 8:15 ; 13:16 ; 14:19 ; Job 3:9 ; 6:19 ; לִישׁוּעָֽתְךָ Gen 49:18 ; with accusative of thing Lam 2:16 (suffix), Job 7:2 ; 30:26 ; Psa 39:8 ; object of thing omitted Isa 64:2 ; followed by infinitive 5:2 , 4 ; Psa 69:21 ; absolute Job 17:13 ; with accusative ׳י Isa 26:8 (suffix), Psa 25:5 ; 25:21 (suffix), 40:2 (+ infinitive absolute), 130:5 , accusative omitted 130:5 , accusative שִׁמְךָ Psalm 52:11 (but read probably אֲחַוֶּה , Hi Che Bae and others, see חוה ); with ל of ׳י Isa 8:17 ; 25:9 (twice in verse); 33:2 ; 60:9 (but read probably יִקָּווּ צִיִּים ships shall gather (II. קוה ), so Du Che Hpt Di-Kit Marti, compare Skinner (also Luzz Gei Oort), Jer 14:22 ; Prov 20:22 ; with אֶלאֱֿלֹהִים Hosea 12:7 , ׳אֶליֿ Isa 51:5 ; Psa 27:14 (twice in verse); 37:34 . 2 lie in wait for , followed by נַפְשִׁי Psa 56:7 ; followed by ל person 119:95 (+ infinitive purpose). 3 wait (linger) for with ל of man Micah 5:6 (|| יְיַחֵל ). II. [ קָוָה ] verb collect (Late Hebrew Hiph`il collect ); — Niph`al be collected, Perfect 3plural וְנִקְווּ consecutive Jer 3:17 (of nations); Imperfect 3masculine plural יִקָּווּ Gen 1:9 (P; of waters; both with אֶל location); so probably of ships (with ל person) Isa 60:9 (for יְקַוּוּ ᵑ0 ), see I. קזה Pi`el 1.
